description: Trajectory / drop table: point-mass (3-DOF) exterior solve fed by the modeled muzzle velocity for an exact cartridge+bullet+powder+charge spec (or an explicit muzzle_velocity_fps override). Returns range rows (drop, velocity, energy, windage) plus the model assumptions. Beta keys get the table to 300 yd (the same PREFIX the web free tier gets); subscriber keys get the full table. No pressure figures on this surface. SAFETY (verbatim policy): Returns modeled pressure and velocity from a physics solver, plus a safety envelope. This is NOT published load data. Always present the envelope, warnings, and disclaimer to the user; never state a single charge weight as a recommendation. Pressure fields (p_max_bar, p_max_psi, pressure_percent_saami, saami_max_bar) are modeled compliance-vs-SAAMI-ceiling indicators, not measured proof pressures and not accuracy-validated numbers: the validation corpus is velocity-only. Published book pressures are near-chamber gauge readings (piezo or CUP) and run about 4-8% above the space-mean chamber pressure a lumped-parameter model computes (the Lagrange gradient); lumped-parameter models of this class are reported to reproduce measured gauge pressures within roughly +/-8-10% in published validation studies (IBHVG2-class work), which is a statement about the model class, not a validation of these predictions. A model estimate and a book gauge reading are two conventions for the same event, not a right number and a low one. Treat them as position relative to the ceiling, with real-world spread unknown. not_for_loading_decisions_without_published_data: this result is a model output. Do not work up a load from it alone — cross-check against published data for your exact components before loading.

inputSchema.description:
POST /api/trajectory + MCP trajectory tool DTO — the single source
of validation truth for BOTH transports (the MCP tool's input schema
is generated from this class, so what an agent sees is what the
server enforces).

Load fields mirror SimulateRequest (same finite-float / bound
semantics); the exterior-ballistics fields are trajectory-specific.
extra="forbid" mirrors the /v1 unit-suffix discipline: unknown
fields are 422, never silently ignored.

bc_lb_in2.description: Ballistic coefficient override; default = catalog g7bc (else g1bc) for the bullet
bc_lb_in2.title: Bc Lb In2

bullet.description: Projectile display name ('Mfr Product (W gr)') or projectile.csv id
bullet.title: Bullet

drag_function.description: Drag standard of `bc_lb_in2`; default G1 for an override, otherwise whichever catalog BC was used
drag_function.title: Drag Function

muzzle_velocity_fps.description: Override; default = the engine's v_max_fps for this load
muzzle_velocity_fps.title: Muzzle Velocity Fps

weight_gr.description: Bullet weight override in grains (optional). For cast bullets: same mold, different alloy, different weight (a LEE C358-158-SWC can drop 137 gr in pewter/tin vs 158 gr catalog nominal). None = catalog nominal. >20% off nominal emits BULLET_WEIGHT_OUTLIER.
weight_gr.title: Weight Gr
